item.title: Here’s How Olivia Rodrigo Feels About Possibly Collaborating With Sabrina Carpenter Someday
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest update on the music scene. Today, we're talking about Olivia Rodrigo, the rising star behind hits like "Drivers License". In a recent interview with Dazed, Rodrigo opened up about potential collaborations with her fellow Gen-Z pop stars.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: When asked about working with Sabrina Carpenter, Rodrigo didn't rule it out, saying "I'm open to all types of collaboration." This might come as a surprise, given their past history. But it seems Rodrigo is all about spreading the love, having recently told British Vogue that she thinks Carpenter is "great" and is happy for her success.
[Music transitions to a slightly different tune]
Host: Rodrigo also shared her dream collaborations, naming PJ Harvey and Fiona Apple as artists she'd love to work with. She's been listening to their music lately and admires their raw and unfiltered style. And as for Lorde, another one of her musical heroes, Rodrigo said she's "amazing" and that her album "Pure Heroine" has had a big influence on her songwriting.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. It's exciting to see what the future holds for Olivia Rodrigo and her potential collaborations. Stay tuned for more updates on the music scene. [Outro music continues to play until the end]
